evaluation.results_summary: The developer reports that the Qwen2.5-Math-7B base model achieves strong results on English mathematical benchmarks, with scores of 91.6 on GSM8K and 55.4 on MATH. The broader Qwen2.5-Math family is described as capable of solving simple math competition problems, and the model family's evaluations cover both English and Chinese mathematical benchmarks.

identity.name: Qwen2.5-Math-7B
identity.summary: Qwen2.5-Math-7B is a math-specific base language model supporting English and Chinese math problems through chain-of-thought and tool-integrated reasoning.

possible_risks.description: Poor model accuracy occurs when a model's performance is insufficient to the task it was designed for. Low accuracy might occur if the model is not correctly engineered, or if the model's expected inputs change.
possible_risks.justification: The card reports only English benchmark scores (GSM8K 91.6, MATH 55.4) for this checkpoint, so performance on Chinese math problems and many real-world math tasks is unverified, making accuracy insufficient for the claimed bilingual math scope.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: It is a math-specific base language model with no reported factual grounding or verification mechanism, so chain-of-thought/tool-integrated reasoning may produce plausible but incorrect mathematical statements.

possible_risks.description: Improper usage occurs when a model is used for a purpose that it was not originally designed for.
possible_risks.justification: The card describes a math-specific base model but does not report any use-case restrictions or safety evaluation, so it could plausibly be applied outside its intended math scope.
